g.text: Figure 1 | Preserving meaning from expert responses to grouped claims.

text.style: font-size: 8.2px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; fill: #514b58

g.text: A–B, Exact coverage and faithfulness scores from 76 paired synthetic panels; purple is extraction and copper is grouping. Marginal ticks show empirical

text.style: font-size: 8.2px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; fill: #514b58

g.text: frequencies. Coincident panels are counted, not displaced; density contours are used only when at least 30 panels and six distinct coordinates are available.

text.style: font-size: 8.2px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; fill: #514b58

g.text: C, Full and partial retention after grouping, pooled over reference occurrences in the available nested sizes for each topic. D, Individual panel retention

text.style: font-size: 8.2px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; fill: #514b58

g.text: by reference category; dots and lines show medians and interquartile ranges, not confidence intervals. Vertical jitter separates observations without

text.style: font-size: 8.2px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; fill: #514b58

g.text: changing scores. Density estimates, where shown, use reflected Gaussian smoothing with a fixed 3.5-percentage-point bandwidth. Sources and references were

text.style: font-size: 8.2px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; fill: #514b58

g.text: model-authored and frozen before extraction; judgments are provisional and not human validated. Similar meanings from different speakers may be counted

text.style: font-size: 8.2px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; fill: #514b58

g.text: separately. Grouping is capped at eight statements. This is a benchmark of prompts, not the deployed platform pipeline; no causal size effect is established.
